fusions.name: Measured Bound
fusions.desc: Bounds at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and deals 26 piercing damage, rising to double that at 7 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Textbook Finish
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. It deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. Then your movement speed rises by 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Run It Back
fusions.desc: You spring 3 tiles aside and clear the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. You gain 6% dodge chance.
